_comment: Wording for the assessment screens. Advisory decision support only: never use diagnostic words. Status labels, reasons and recommendations themselves come from the API (prism-ml2.0/config/labels.json).

role._comment: Only hides admin screens in the UI. The API checks the role on every request.

states.api_unavailable: Assessment service unavailable. Live sensor readings are still shown.
states.local_fallback: Computed on this phone from the last saved rules because the assessment service is unavailable.
states.no_local_rules: No saved rules on this phone yet. Connect once to download them.
states.forecast_none: No forecast: no approved model is active, or the data is not good enough.
states.admin_required: Admin access required. Model information is restricted.
states.rejected_input: The reading was rejected by the assessment service's range checks.
states.phone_time: Device clock not synced; the phone's receive time was used.

live.pen_surface: Pen surface temperature (thermal camera, whole pen)

card.title: Growth trend
card.unavailable: Growth check unavailable: cannot reach the assessment service.
card.auth_rejected: Growth check unavailable: the assessment service did not accept the sign-in. Sign out and in again, or check the server's Firebase settings.
card.rejected_input: Growth check unavailable: the weight records were rejected by the service's checks.
card.service_error: Growth check unavailable: the assessment service reported an error.
card.weights_unavailable: Growth check unavailable: this pig's weight records could not be read.
